title: Declaration of Independence
creator: John Trumbull; reproduction credited to Architect of the Capitol
license: Public domain; faithful reproduction of public domain art; U.S. federal government photograph
description: Retrospective painting of the drafting committee presenting its work to the Second Continental Congress on June 28, 1776. This is not a photograph or an eyewitness record of a signing on July 4. Architect of the Capitol dates production to August 1817–September 1818; Commons and U.S. Currency Education Program catalog the image as 1819. 1800×1182 JPEG, resized and compressed without compositional edits.

title: The Declaration of Independence — original parchment, front
creator: Continental Congress; digital reproduction courtesy of the National Archives
license: Public domain; National Archives explicitly permits reuse and requests source credit
description: Image of the actual aged parchment Declaration of Independence, rather than the 1823 William J. Stone engraving. The Declaration was adopted July 4, 1776; most delegates signed the engrossed parchment on August 2. 630×766 JPEG, compressed for the web without content changes.

title: Statue of Liberty, New York, N.Y.

description: Authentic historic photograph of the Statue of Liberty viewed from the harbor. Library of Congress item 2016795971; reproduction LC-DIG-det-4a23254. Date range and rights statement checked in the Library record and JSON metadata. 1024×811 JPEG, compressed without cropping.
